r.경제 체제: Market economy · minerals, IT, close ties to the Russian economy
r.주식시장 시가총액: $4.8 billion, 19% of GDP (2024, listed domestic companies)
r.생활 물가 수준: 41% of the US level (2025, World Bank, household consumption at purchasing power parity against the market exchange rate)
r.주요 수출품: Gold, precious metals, gems 34%, Phones, telecom equipment 14%, Ores 13%, Tobacco 8%, Whisky and spirits 5% (2025, share of all exports, top 5)
r.한국이 파는 것: Precision and medical instruments 35%, Cars 19%, Coated steel sheet 6%, Other machinery, computers 5% (2025, share of value)
r.여행경보: Parts of the country: Travel ban · Parts of the country: Avoid travel · Rest of the country: Exercise caution
r.정치 구도: A parliamentary system; a 2018 civic revolution brought a change of government.

t.why: After a long territorial conflict with Azerbaijan, it agreed on a draft peace deal in 2025. It is trying to move away from Russia and closer to the West.
t.rel: After decades of conflict with Azerbaijan over Nagorno-Karabakh, it lost the region in 2023 and agreed on a draft peace deal in 2025. It is trying to move away from dependence on Russia and closer to the West.
t.know: Far more Armenians live abroad than in Armenia.
t.etext: Minerals such as copper and molybdenum, plus brandy, are its main exports. Its IT industry has grown quickly, and remittances and investment from the diaspora are large. As a member of the Russia-centered economic union, it is strongly affected by the Russian economy.
